title: Line sketch: Timekeeper's Surreal Throne
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A majestic winged queen with a crown and mechanical wings sits on an ornate throne that merges into a sprawling and patterned dress across a vast landscape. The dramatic sky swirls with dark clouds, floating bubbles containing miniature scenes, clockwork mechanisms, and dragonflies while a hand in the foreground holds a pocket watch (derived from generated still #1842).
